
Rule Name:                            Remote Desktop - User Mode (TCP-In)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Enabled:                              Yes
Direction:                            In
Profiles:                             Domain,Private,Public
Grouping:                             Remote Desktop
LocalIP:                              Any
RemoteIP:                             Any
Protocol:                             TCP
LocalPort:                            3389
RemotePort:                           Any
Edge traversal:                       No
Action:                               Allow
Ok.
